name: @etzhayyim/aima-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of the aima knowledge-graph data layer (entities + events + reports) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RisingWave/Postgres backing). The embedding/inference/mesh AI-compute components stay etzhayyim infra (consent-capability). Public graph data; no PII/settlement. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
